context:
Goal: review rounds catch real defects at the lowest cost.
Problem (rule): the role rules agent-model-cap and roles-review-cap-three set each round's model and the number of rounds, and only you change them.
Based on (measured): about 80% parse accuracy over 859 PRs, 2026-10-24 to 11-07. Haiku FAILs 79% of PRs at round 1 (73 of 92), and Sonnet or Opus 38% (18 of 48). After a Haiku round-1 FAIL, round 2 fails again 31% of the time, against 19% after another model. 15% of all FAILs are about wording only. Round 3 failed 3 times in 114 reviews, and never after a round-2 PASS (0 of at least 14). The net-value test held nothing in 14 days.
Based on (ruling): agent-model-cap: reviewers run Sonnet from round 2, and round 1 uses the role's model. Asked again because of your 13:41 CST question.
Departs from: main, where round 1 runs on Haiku and round 3 runs at xhigh on every change. Each choice changes one part.
Side by side: item 351 (the fix check of a guard runs on Sonnet) is close to a. a covers round 1 and 351 covers the fix check, so they fit together.

options.gain: Fewer false FAILs and fewer repeat FAILs on the risky PRs.
options.label: Round 1 runs on Sonnet for guard and check diffs; Haiku stays for docs and records (recommended)
options.lose: More Sonnet tokens on guard PRs (cost unmeasured). Checked again after a week.

options.gain: About 14 or more round-3 reviews saved every 2 weeks, and less effort elsewhere.
options.label: Skip round 3 unless the change touches a guard or check, or round 2 failed; a guard's round 3 is a net-value read at high effort, not xhigh (recommended)
options.lose: The rare real round-3 catch (1 in 114).

options.gain: About 15% fewer false FAILs. Should-fix and wording findings are fixed before merge, with no new round, so no gap is filed instead of fixed. The merge tool refuses a review record whose model is "unknown", so every record names its model.
options.label: Label each finding blocker, should-fix or wording; only a blocker FAILs the round (recommended)
options.lose: A small defect may slip. Watch the round-2 FAIL rate.

ref: item 356; item 351; rules agent-model-cap and roles-review-cap-three
short: Review rounds: Sonnet round 1 on guards, skip round 3, blocker-only FAIL
title: Which changes to the review rounds' models and prompts do you want?
why: Your 356 note, 13:41 CST: "should we also consider reworking our 3 round program in terms of what models they use what prompts etc?" A read-only audit agent (Explore, Sonnet) measured 859 PRs.
